notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 4332). The game is not in the fetched Steam store app list (searches for "Spec Ops" and "The Line" find other games), so it looks delisted. RAWG's store links give Steam app 50300, and the Steam Web API still returns its schema (named "ValveTestApp50300", a placeholder) with 50 achievements and global percentages, so it was used. StrategyWiki has no page under "Spec Ops: The Line" or "Spec Ops The Line". specops.fandom.com answers the API under "Spec Ops: The Line" with about 70 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 50 achievements is hidden, but the 20 story ones (API names Achievement_YEA_STORY_01 to 20) have short cryptic descriptions and name no chapter, so they were placed by display name. STORY_01 to 08 fall steadily from 82.7% to 40.8% and look like progress milestones, split four and four by our own choice. STORY_09 to 20 come in pairs ("Damned if You Do" and "Damned if You Don't", "A Line, Crossed" and "A Line, Held", "The Road Back" and "The Road To Glory") and look like choices; they sit in one choices chapter. RAWG says the game has multiplayer and a two-player co-op mode, but no Steam achievement names either, so there is no chapter for them.
